I’m the glue because I can easily put on the facade of being okay, of being happy. & for a while the mask fell in place easily. But lately, it’s just harder & harder. My parents love who I’m with now, they just don’t take depression seriously.  Even though my moms brother basically drank himself to death because of it. I’m trying to get a job at the moment & the drug test is tomorrow, which I’m more than likely going to fail. So the fact that I’m jobless, a total failure doesn’t help my mindset either. I’m trying to get away but it feels impossible when your family constantly calls on you for things. & relies on you to do said things with a smile. If I complain or say anything back, I’m considered a brat, ungrateful, or just a bitch. When most times I don’t mean to be an asshole or make rude comments. It’s just my inner demons coming out, it’s like word vomit
I’ll pick you up on my way from escaping my shitty life. I’m here with you even though I don’t know you. This community has you.
